entity.summary: India-based centralized cryptocurrency exchange providing INR and crypto spot markets, account-based trading, staking, and API access under the KoinBX brand.
entity.notes: Current first-party legal and compliance pages identify KoinBX as an Indian exchange and report FIU-IND reporting-entity registration. Current independent market data reports recently updated INR, USDT, BTC, and ETH spot markets, but many pairs carry anomaly flags; those volume figures are not treated as quality evidence. FIU registration is recorded as an AML reporting framework, not as broad prudential authorization. No exact launch date is asserted.

evidence.title: KoinBX FIU registration and exchange services
evidence.notes: Current first-party compliance page identifies KoinBX as an Indian cryptocurrency exchange, reports FIU-IND registration number VA00048773, and describes spot trading and account services.

evidence.title: KoinBX exchange profile and current markets
evidence.notes: Current independent exchange profile identifies KoinBX as an India-registered centralized exchange and reports recently updated spot markets. Anomaly-marked volume is not used beyond confirming a live market surface.
